newsitem.title: RUSSIA: PRESS DIGEST - RUSSIA IZVESIA - APRIL 17.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - RUSSIA IZVESIA - APRIL 17.

text.p: The following are some of the leading stories in the April 18 edition of Russia's Izvestia newspaper. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- An attack on the freedom of press is an attack on democracy, prominent Russian intellectuals say in a joint statement published by the paper.
- Despite differences in opinions between Russian and German leaders on NATO expansion, President Boris Yeltsin's visit to Germany is a 100-percent success, the paper says.
- A widely publicised reform of communal services, if implemented the way the government plans now, is likely to lead to serious social unrest.

- After a failed attempt to create a unified state with Russia according to his own design, Belarussian President Alexander Lukashenko rejects the idea of unification. -- Svetlana Kovaleva, Moscow Newsroom, +7095 941 8520
